title: Rava bar Afiton
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Yalkut, Esther, 1056](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.1056.15), where he speaks in the name of Rabbi Elazar ben Shamua, who heard it from his teacher: [Ahasuerus’s scepter stretched two hundred cubits]. Hyman calls this a scribal error and proposes Rabbah bar Rav Ofran, as in [Megillah 15b](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.15b.10), and reports the same reading in Midrash Lekach Tov.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Yalkut reads Rava bar Afiton in the name of Rabbi Elazar ben Shamua. The Yalkut adds that Elazar’s teacher heard it in turn from his own teacher.

The linked Megillah gives Rabbah bar Ofran and Rabbi Elazar without the patronymic. It preserves both links between Elazar and his teachers. [Heilprin’s Ofran notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2858&lang=en) names Rabbah as Ofran’s son. Hyman calls the Yalkut reading a scribal error and cites Lekach Tov in support of his proposed correction.
